title: Checks on the integrated v6 build (organizer main + Mac client hackathon/base)
data: synthetic only; the end-to-end runs used synthetic data roots, a throwaway organizer instance on one Spark node and the iOS 26.5 simulator

code.organizer: main ab83adb (privacy-v6, phone-link-v6 and quality-v6 merged; masking spec v3; sealed-only phone inbox)
code.mac: hackathon/base 0175555 (privacy-v6 with the review fixes, phone-link-v6, masking spec v3, people pass on the Mac)

masking_spec.note: v2 had 184 vectors; v3 adds a code handed over later in the same sentence. The masking-quality evaluation in eval.json (masking_eval) was measured with spec v1 and was not re-run on v2 or v3.

organizer_pytest_mac.note: Python 3.12, SQLCipher 4.12.0; the skip is a Linux-only memory limit, the expected failure documents review finding F13

iphone_app_simulator.note: iOS 26.5 simulator; the skip is on-device zh-CN recognition (the simulator has no speech models)

runs.why: a shared photo was parked on the Mac: its send copy's text recognition failed once and was treated as permanent (fixed: a transient failure is retried)
harness: exact Date equality after a JSON round trip (fixed: compared to 1 ms)
the retried photo kept failing because on-device text recognition stayed broken for the process (fixed: one request at a time, GPU then CPU fallback)

phone.after_unpair: the phone's next send failed with authentication; nothing reached the inbox
phone.authorized_keys: restored byte-identical on the Spark and on the relay host after every run

organizer_live_check.note: real Qwen3.6 and embeddings; unlock, access proof, consolidation and person-resolve ran, delete then re-post gave 410, blob_bytes 0, sealed entry accepted, plaintext refused, lock gave 423, wipe cleared the key id

not_done: the merged v6 build was not re-run on the three scale scenarios; the quality numbers in eval.json were measured on the quality branch without the privacy changes
no run on a real iPhone (on-device Chinese recognition, microphone, background, cellular)
the skills whose SKILL.md gained one line (placeholders, material-is-data) and the placeholder repair were not re-benchmarked with the model
